record.title: Peñas Blancas trucker blockade over regional freight restrictions, October 2020
record.direction: Freight crossing in both directions; report does not disaggregate.
record.exceptions: Border offices remained staffed; passenger scope not established.
record.imposing_authority: Freight transporters on Costa Rican side
record.relationship: Later, separate blockade within the regional freight dispute also underlying AM032/AM033; not a continuation of their May episodes.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Transporters demanded reciprocal freight access, removal of GPS controls and longer permitted stays.
record.context: Distinct physical blockade layered over the wider COVID-related freight dispute.
record.uncertainty: EFE on October 12 quotes transport-association president that Peñas Blancas reopened Friday October 9 and freight was entering/leaving normally. Exact onset is unresolved: La Nación documents October 8 obstruction, while an indexed Repretel report is dated October 7 but its live metadata changed to 2026. Month-level onset retained; no exact duration.
